Supply chain, logistics, inventory & sales platform

Platform architecture & processes

What has been built so far: the system's structure, how a consignment moves from plan to reconciliation, how data flows, who uses what, and the data kept by each module. Version 1.2 · 25 October 2026 · source of truth: the code in this repository.

New in 1.2. The client's real roster (Daniel, Michael, Kabonge, Testfie, Joel, Eric, Moses, Asie, Yonas, drivers) with an access matrix scoped by company, buyer–supplier pair, loading point, warehouse and route; loaders, receivers and drivers see no prices, and Testfie records the agreed transport price after loading. Warehouse money (expenses, stock counts, re-exports Asie → Yonas, transport-fee ageing, selling prices), landed cost v2 and the combined performance report; 31 dashboards behind one endpoint GET /v1/dashboards, with a home screen per person on the web and the phone. Migrations 0009 and 0010. POs are issued without an approval step (still a switch in config.toml, off).

3apps on one server: office web, phone app (field roles + office team PWA), API
9named people + drivers, each scoped by company, pair, loading point or warehouse
39database tables (PostgreSQL + PostGIS)
6integrations behind adapters: SMS/USSD, email, push, files, PDF, routing

The arrows move on screen (this HTML file, or the .drawio files opened in draw.io / diagrams.net, where each diagram can be edited). In print or PDF they appear as static dashed lines. Click a diagram to open it full screen.

1 · Architecture

One server, light apps, swappable integrations

diagrams/01-architecture.drawio

Clients. Office staff use the web app, or the team phone app (PWA) at /app/; the three field roles use the Android app, which queues work offline and sends it in one batch. Drivers without data can check in by SMS or USSD.

Server. One NestJS process serves the apps and the API at the same address. Every request passes auth, role, feature and scope checks (company, pair, loading point, warehouse) and is written to the audit log before a domain service runs the shared business rules. Business switches and thresholds come from config.toml.

Data & integrations. PostgreSQL/PostGIS holds all operational data, including checkpoints and GPS. Each external service sits behind an adapter: without a key it uses a local stand-in, so nothing changes in code when keys are added.

Office web appHome per person, 31 dashboards (PDF / Excel / CSV), plans, POs, queues, Truck desk, warehouse money, re-exports, fees, selling prices, static data, users, audit log.Svelte 5 + Vite · 100.3 KB first load · lazy charts

Team phone app (PWA)Office staff at /app/: a home per person (directors' scorecard, Kabonge's pipeline, Testfie's fleet) with one-list drill-downs. Installable from the browser.apps/field/src/team
API gatewaySign-in (password or phone + PIN), refresh tokens, role, feature & scope guard (company, pair, loading point, warehouse, route), audit with before / after, idempotency keys.NestJS 11 on Fastify · JWT · bcrypt
Domain servicesPlanning & PO, logistics, stock, warehouse money, re-exports, sales, fees, performance, dashboards, notifications, sync. Rules shared with the apps.TypeScript · packages/api/src/ rules, access, performance, dashboards
Data39 tables; nested items (plan lines, passes, issues, ack lines) as JSON in their parent record; GPS and geofences as PostGIS geography.PostgreSQL 17 + PostGIS 3.5 · Drizzle ORM
IntegrationsSMS/USSD (Africa's Talking), email, push (Firebase), files, PDF letters (Typst), routing (OSRM); each with a local stand-in.Adapters selected from .env
Business settingsPO approval (off), allowance ±10%, revision suffix, [fees] 14 / 30 days, [costs] allocation. Sent in GET /v1/ref.apps/api/config.toml (or CONFIG_FILE)

Life of a request — a driver's check-in

  1. The driver slides I've arrived at Malaba; the app stores it in the outbox with a unique key and, when online, sends POST /v1/sync/batch.
  2. The gateway checks the token, role and that the leg belongs to this driver, audits the call, and the idempotency check applies a retried item once only.
  3. The tracking service records the pass, recalculates leg status and ETA, and raises alerts.
  4. A result per item comes back; the app clears the outbox. Office screens see the change on their next refresh.

Running it

pnpm start starts the database and email inbox (Docker), migrates, seeds demo data if empty, builds both apps and serves everything from http://localhost:3101: / web, /app/ field, /brand/ logos, /v1 API.

Quality gates. pnpm verify (type-check, workflow test, API test, builds, size budget) · test:qa 1,108 API, access-matrix, money, dashboard, security and integration checks (all passing) · pnpm e2e browser journeys with the named users.

2 · Process

From planning to reconciliation, by actor

diagrams/02-process.drawio

Read left to right. Each lane is a person or the system. Solid moving arrows are steps one person does in order; dotted orange moving arrows are hand-overs and notifications between people. Kabonge's PO is issued at once (no approval step). The diamond is the receiver's "final destination?", which either posts stock or sends the goods on — at Gisenyi Asie raises and loads a re-export to Yonas in Juba. Loaders hand over without prices; Testfie records the agreed price after loading, follows every truck and its costs; the directors set selling prices, pay fees and read the dashboards.

2 · Process

Process steps and reconciliations

PhaseWhoWhat happensSystem record & control
1 Period planKabongeA suggestion per company and period; he edits only his pairs' lines. No approval; each save is a version. It gates nothing.Active / Replaced; no overlapping Active plans (409 → “Replace?”).
2 Purchase orderKabonge (BTW–KBL, Nihna–UBL, Kivu–SBL); directors (Nihna–GBI)Fills truck lines and taps Issue purchase order. Letter on the company letterhead, emailed to the supplier.Ref per company and year (BTW-PO-2026-0002); “ISSUED” stamp; no approval step (switch off).
3 Load & dispatchJoel, Eric (KBL) · Moses (UBL) · Testfie (GBI) · Testfie after loadingTestfie and Kabonge order the queue. The loader loads from the PO within ±10%, may load alternatives, adds photos and slides Hand over — no prices. Testfie then records the agreed transport price.Any difference → PO revision …-rev001 (auto-issued, notified); shipments follow the latest revision.
4 Route & monitorDriver · TestfieDriver checks in at each checkpoint (slide, automatic geofence, or SMS/USSD), reports problems and "fixed".ETA early / on time / late; overdue and border-wait alerts.
5 ReceiveAsie (Gisenyi, Goma) · Yonas (Juba)"Everything arrived OK", or adjust received / damaged per brand with a reason and photos; signs. Asie re-exports Rwanda → Juba as a new shipment ASIE-RX-….Discrepancy alert; loss reasons feed the Pareto; Yonas acknowledges re-exports.
6 Inventory & salesSystem · Asie, Yonas · directorsStock posts at the warehouse after acknowledgement; receivers record expenses and stock counts (quantities only); directors sell at their selling prices.Ledger per warehouse and SKU; sale above stock blocked unless a director overrides.
7 ReconcileDirectors · Testfie (transport side)Transport fees paid against references; landed cost v2, profit and margins at product, warehouse, company and business level.Fee age flags; combined performance report; dashboards and alerts.

Reconciliations the platform performs

CheckRuleWhere it shows
Ordered vs loadedTruck total within ±allowance_pct of the PO and never above capacity; otherwise refused. A difference creates the next revision, numbered from the original PO; superseded orders are not counted twice.Allowance meter at hand-over, PO revision chain
Loaded vs received, per legEach leg: loaded − received = short; damaged counted separately; the next leg carries only good cases forward, so a loss is pinned to the leg where it happened.Shipment reconciliation table, discrepancy alert
Stock ledgerOpening + received + transfers in − transfers out − damaged ± adjustments − sold = closing; in-transit shown separately.Inventory (with ledger per SKU)
Transport feesAgreed price (recorded by Testfie after loading) vs payments with status Paid; age from loading, amber at 14 and red at 30 days while unpaid or part paid.Transport fees, unpaid & ageing dashboard
Landed cost v2Goods + every trip cost of the shipment + the warehouse's share of its month's expenses, ÷ good cases received (page 6).Performance report, landed cost dashboards
Offline replayEach phone action has one key; replays apply once and return the stored result.Sync screen, audit log

Data flow — landed cost v2 packages/api/src/performance.ts

Goodscases loaded × PO price loadings · pos
+
Truckevery trip cost of the shipment, all legs, split by cases trip_costs
+
Warehouse sharemonth's expenses ÷ good cases received that month × the line's good cases warehouse_expenses · acks
÷
Quantity receivedreceived − damaged acks
=
Landed cost per case× cases sold = cost of units sold sales

Profit = revenue − cost of units sold · margin = profit ÷ revenue · price for a target margin = landed cost per case ÷ (1 − target). Goods sent on or re-exported carry the landed cost per case of the warehouse they left. Split by cases ([costs] allocation = "quantity") or by value. Example: $12.98 / case, 600 sold at $15 → profit $1,212.18, margin 13.47 %.

4 · Use cases

Who does what

diagrams/04-use-cases.drawio

Office roles (left) work in the web app or the team phone app (PWA). Field roles (right) use one task-focused screen each in the field app; drivers without data use SMS or USSD. Every action is limited to the person's scope: companies, buyer–supplier pairs (Kabonge), loading points (loaders; Testfie at GBI Mombasa), warehouses (Asie, Yonas) and, optionally, routes. Directors set up users, pairs and static data and read the audit log.
